units: <cite ref="Chullin 47b:2">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ דאוני</he> the incisions marking the lobes of the lung.—Pl. <he>חִיתּוּכֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 48a:7">Ib. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ דאוני</he> ed. (Rashi: <he>מקום חיתוכה דאוני</he>) the place in the neck where the lungs begin to separate.

senses.gloss: a portion cut off, segment (חֲתִיכָה). Ib. 48ᵇ מחטא … בח׳ דריאה (Rashi: בחִיתּוּכָהּ) a needle was found in a segment of the lungs.
